title: Anus Heresiarchus
html_source: Should be Arius Heresiarchus. Probably easy to miss in this scene of clamorous vulgarity and lewdness. Of Libyan birth, a priest in Alexandria, his teachings concerning the nature of the relationship between The Father and the Son within the Trinity were considered heretical. He died after suffering a colonic hemorrhage – (the agony in the closet – water closet).
